description: Create a properly formatted community grant proposal document. The file /home/ga/Documents/grant_notes.txt contains rough project notes. Create a professional proposal document at /home/ga/Documents/CommunityGrant_Proposal.docx with: (1) Project title 'Community Tool Library Initiative', (2) Four main sections with Heading 1 style: Executive Summary, Problem Statement, Proposed Solution, and Budget Justification, (3) A budget table in the Budget Justification section with 3 columns (Item, Description, Cost) and at least 4 line items plus a TOTAL row. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
